value.rationale: Complete finite-size ground-state classification and all-field critical-point count for a canonical frustrated rook lattice are motivated physical invariants. In two odd dimensions the field-induced magnetization jumps by 2 min(a,b), unlike even-side zero plateau; exact a+b-gcd count reveals a nontrivial aspect-ratio arithmetic effect. This goes beyond isolated small-graph enumerations or a single pre-known max-cut number.
